blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Letran continued its redemption run in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament, eliminating Mapua with an 86-75 victory in the quarterfinals at San Juan Arena on Tuesday. The Knights advanced to the best-of-three semifinals against Jose Rizal University, which secured its spot after beating Arellano, starting on Monday. Rookie Justin Cargo led Letran with 19 points, three rebounds, two assists and two steals, delivering a composed performance in what Letran treated as a do-or-die game. “This was a big challenge for us because losing this game would put us at a disadvantage heading into the next one,” he said.
